steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...A ship's log?

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You recognize that?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: It's something mariners used to use to record what happened on their voyages.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: So, you seen a lot of this sorta thing?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...Sí. My teacher taught me many things.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Must've had guts to do that.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: So are you going to stand behind me and commentate all day, or...?

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Think it was my idea, chaval? Bosun told me to keep a close eye on you.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I'm sure you can do that without literally breathing down my neck.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: That sound... I know that sound...
Isidro looks around vigilantly, warned by the sound on the salt wind. Behind the sailor, he sees a familiar dent appear on the surface of the salt.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Out of the way! Saltfin incoming!

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You got finshit for brains?!

steps.name: Saltfin
steps.text: Mreep... Mreep...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You shoved me aside for this?

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You think it was one of them giant saltfins or something?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Shut up...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: If it were, the whole ground'd be shaking. One of these small fry just leaves a little dent is all.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Besides, they're the same sorta critter as Nene. What's it gonna do, cuddle you to death?

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: What's that crazy puta even need from a guy as stupid as you, anyway?!

steps.name: Nene
steps.text: Mmph...

steps.name: Saltfin
steps.text: Mreep...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: They're... the same species?

steps.name: Saltfin
steps.text: Mreep...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: So there's more than one variety of saltfin out here?

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Yep. About ten or so types, big and small.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Some of your sails are made from leather. Are they...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Saltfin hide. Also use it for tents.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: And the meat you hang out to dry outside...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Saltfin meat.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Your weapons...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Saltfin bones.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: And those guys are...

steps.name: Nene
steps.text: Mmph...

steps.name: Saltfin
steps.text: Mreep...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: They ain't the same. Won't hurt 'em unless we really have to.

spans.text: They ain't the same. Won't hurt 'em unless we

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: The crazy puta loves 'em to death. Once tried to haul some aboard to raise them, but a day away from their friends and they lose all the spirit. She had to give up that loco plan.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Then why's that one part of the crew?

steps.name: Nene
steps.text: Mm-ph.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Nene was abandoned by its mates. Couldn't keep up with 'em thanks to its weak body. Lucky for it, she went and picked it up.

spans.text: Nene was abandoned by its mates. Couldn't keep up with 'em thanks to its weak body. Lucky for it,

steps.name: Saltfin
steps.text: Cheep...

steps.name: Nene
steps.text: Mm-ph!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: They're leaving?

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: That's normal. They don't stay in one place for too long.
One after the other, the saltfins drill into the salt, speeding off into the distance.
Their tracks lace and intertwine, leaving the salt surface looking like a cracked mirror.
They fascinate Isidro. He climbs up on a jagged rock, hoping to get a better look at the where the cracks are headed from a higher vantage point.
He stands at its peak, and to his surprise, he sees an immense gash barreling towards them, swallowing up any salt reefs or skeletons in its path.
He realizes the saltfins weren't leaving. They were fleeing.

steps.name: Nene
steps.text: (Runs around anxiously)

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: No... That's definitely not normal.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: You see something?!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Move! Quickly!
In an instant, the ground splits into a gaping maw, threatening to devour the two as they sprint away.
Cesc stumbles as he tries to flee, the collapsing earth grabbing at his ankle. He screams in terror.
Isidro grabs hold of his arm, but he soon finds out he is powerless against nature's brute strength.
Just as the two are about to be swallowed whole, the collapse miraculously stops. The sailor's lower leg is wedged tight between the jagged earth, now nothing more than a bloody, mangled mess.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: The hell's going on over there?!

steps.name: Flustered Sailor
steps.text: The salt split open! I think someone fell in!

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Go have a look then, quick!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I'll be going now.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Get back here, you capullo! Don't even think about running!

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Hey... Don't leave me here by myself...

steps.name: Nene
steps.text: Mm... hmph...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Your crewmates will be over soon. You'll be fine.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Wh... Where are you going?

steps.name: Nene
steps.text: (Nips at Isidro's pants)

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Not sure. Somewhere you can't find me.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: ...N—No... You can't go.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Bosun's... orders... I... have to keep an eye on you.

steps.name: Nene
steps.text: *Glub*—!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I haven't been here to see you for so long...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: All is going according to plan.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Yes, we've taken a few risks, but they were worth it.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Soon we will set our sails once more, and return to the ocean's embrace.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Are you happy for me?
The sound of metal scraping against stone echoes out from the cave, followed by a slender Seaborn slowly slithering its way out, its form warped and twisted.
Each of its tentacles is wrapped around a weapon. As their points and edges drag across the stone walls, they keen and wail.
It slowly approaches the saltfin meat, and slowly eats away at it, its eyes fixed on Juana the entire time.
She meets its gaze, quietly waiting for the Seaborn's reply.
But in her heart, she knows that it is no more than a beast, a beast without a speck of intellect or humanity.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We will leave this place, this desert of salt. No matter the price.
Juana turns and exits the cave, leaving behind only the Seaborn, trashing around like a caged animal now that it has finished its meal.
Rocks fall from the ceiling until finally, it ceases its struggle for a way out, slowly calming down in the darkness.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Dios mio... What happened here? Did that boy do this?!

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: N—No, it was my fault... B—But he ran away...

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Forget him! You lot come over and help pull him out.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: AHHHH! MY LEG!

steps.name: Flustered Sailor
steps.text: Bosun, his leg...

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Speak up!

steps.name: Flustered Sailor
steps.text: I—I don't think we can save it! We need to call the surgeon!

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: When's the last time we had a surgeon...

steps.name: Flustered Sailor
steps.text: But only a surgeon'd know how to cut it off right! Else he'll bleed to death!

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: I don't wanna die here...

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Save me, bosun! Save me!

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Cesc... I...
I'm here. I know what to do.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Chaval...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: He'll live. I guarantee it.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Good. Get over here.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Bite down on the hilt. Hard.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Grkh...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: This'll sting a little. Just bear with it.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: GKKHHH—!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thorns!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: How could they do you dirty like this on your own wanted poster? What's with that picture?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: ...Why are you so quick to concede that it's Thorns now? Weren't you just insisting it was all a mistaken identity?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What if those bandits forced him into it? Or maybe he was framed? He's not much of a talker. I can definitely see him putting his foot in his mouth while explaining himself.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: If he is the upstanding young man you say he is, then surely he's dead by now, killed by either the bandits or by the dangers of the Salt Flat.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: No... What exactly would they do to him?

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: They like to... No, you would be happier not knowing.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: We've done all we can to keep them away from town, but they've still managed to abduct some of our best and brightest.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Their leader is a vile monster, able to corrupt the hearts of others.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Time to start cooking... Hmm? Who touched my kitchen?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: (Cautious sniff)

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: That smell... It's coming from the pot over there...

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Stewed fin hearts? This is Señora Juana's specialty.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: But they went bad ages ago. Better put that fire out.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: During the Profound Silence, most of Aarón was submerged under the sea. Only this small part atop the hill avoided that grim fate, but it too shortly fell to chaos as the harvest failed.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: The pirates sailed in before the seawater retreated. They claimed they would bring order to Aarón.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: But in truth, they only wished to burn, kill and maim, forcing the townsfolk to surrender to their reign of terror.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Everything they saw was put to the torch...

steps.name: Anxious Sailor
steps.text: Fire! HELP! FIRE! The pot blew up!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Mierda! Why's there a fire here?!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Javier, you dried-out piece of finshit! How many times do I have to tell you NOT to let this useless cockeyed bastard in the kitchen until he gets some glasses?!

steps.name: Shortsighted Sailor
steps.text: Ohh... It was fin oil... Sorry, was all blurry to me!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: Out of my sight, dumbass!

steps.name: Teach
steps.text: —Where the hell's Javier? Get over here and put out this fire already!

steps.name: Anxious Sailor
steps.text: Quick, cover it with salt!

steps.name: Frightened Sailor
steps.text: Ahh! My clothes! I just sewed up that finleather coat!

steps.name: Hungry Sailor
steps.text: ...Mmm... Roast finleather smells... pretty good...

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Even if he is lucky enough to be alive, the bandits themselves live harsh lives in the wastes. Surely they wouldn't treat their captives well. He's most likely dying of hunger and thirst at this very moment.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Are you alright, Elysium?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm fine... Señor Calificador, please, continue.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Needless to say, we can only pray he does nothing to incur their wrath.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Their punishments are as barbaric as they are capricious. They'll slit open bellies or chop off hands and feet over the slightest offense...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: To think they'd twist the law like that...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: S—Slit open bellies or chop off hands and feet, you say...?

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: AHHH—HHHHH!

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Hah... Hah...

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Get some rum! Give him a swig!

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Rus! Rus! How's my leg...?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Alright... Lie down, and stay calm...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Your leg's still out in the Flat. It won't hurt any longer.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: We've been looking after you here, Cesc. Don't worry, the surgery was a success. You won't be dying today.

steps.name: Cesc
steps.text: Oh... Oh...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I just cut his leg off. I can't call it surgery.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: He's alive. That's surgery enough for us.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Calm down, Elysium. There's nothing to suggest that these bandits have killed him.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I don't want to think too much about the possibility, but... where would we even go to find out?
Weedy does not answer. In the distance, several corpses hang from a pole outside of town, swinging in the wind.
A fowl lands atop it, feasting on the carrion.

steps.name: Pious Townsperson
steps.text: Oh, you two are guests of the Inquisition.

steps.name: Pious Townsperson
steps.text: Those were bandits caught by the Alguacil. They were hanged, all according to the teachings.

steps.name: Tranquil Townsperson
steps.text: Their bodies will serve as a warning to others of their kind.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Dead if you stick with the bandits, dead if you come back looking like a bandit...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thorns...

steps.name: Tottering Old Man
steps.text: Hey, joven, you still want that paper you're holding?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Nah, I don't need it anymore. Here, take it.

steps.name: Tottering Old Man
steps.text: Gracias. Finally found something to stick my bed together with.

steps.name: Tottering Old Man
steps.text: Hmm? Isn't this...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What, have you seen him before?

steps.name: Tottering Old Man
steps.text: Of course I have. I even sheltered him for a night.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: The fleet's heading out into the flat to hunt saltfins in a few days, and I'd like the boy to come along.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: We've lost a lot of men this month, and our surgeon and navigator sacrificed themselves to get us out of the Inquisition's trap. I think he can fill in for their posts.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: That's how you plan to fix our manpower problem?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I only let him help on the salvage ship because of Teach's guarantee, but did he not almost run away today?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: And now you're telling me you want him to join you on a finship.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Señora... I know he's a precious, precious alchemist, but he's great with a sword too and knows his medicine. He'll be real handy during a hunt.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You might as well open the door and let him leave. He'll find no shortage of opportunities to escape out there.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I'm a pirate, Rus. We're not the most kind-hearted sort.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Please, señora, we've lost way too many men in these last few tussles with the Inquisition.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: You're not the only one in this fleet who needs him... We all do.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: He's far from a good little boy, you know. In fact, he's rather naughty. How will you ensure he does as he's told?

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: He'd never met Pascuala before, but he still saved her sorry behind when the Inquisition was chasing her down, and saw her safely to town. Didn't ask for a reward, neither.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: He could've left Cesc to die, but he didn't. Chose to come back and help us save him.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: He... He's a good kid. An honest kid.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: As long as we show him how much we need him, he won't just sit back and watch us suffer.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Any other news from the crew?

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Nothing yet... Nothing about our food supplies for the next month, at least.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Fine, he can go with you.

steps.name: Tottering Old Man
steps.text: So the boy was your friend, then?

steps.name: Tottering Old Man
steps.text: A fine young man. Such a shame what happened... And in the prime of his youth...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Alright, alright, fine!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm going to go find him myself!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Elysium? Elysium!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Weedy, Thorns is definitely out there, waiting for us to save him!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Here, a communicator. You stay in town, I'll head out into the Salt Flat.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Huh... Wha...?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: If anything happens here, contact me! We'll keep in touch—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Take care—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: ELYSIUM!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wait for me, Thorns! I'm coming!

steps.name: Tottering Old Man
steps.text: Why do you kids never let me finish?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You were trying to say...

steps.name: Tottering Old Man
steps.text: It's a shame a fine young man like that would come back to Iberia just to learn a bit of swordplay.

steps.name: Tottering Old Man
steps.text: Wouldn't it be better to live out the rest of your days in some other country?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: This bread is... burnt.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Should still be edible, at least.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: That bunch of useless pricks... I'll cave their skulls in one day, mark my words.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Lucky we didn't lose too much.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: (*chews*)

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Why're you snacking on a lump of charcoal?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Because I'm hungry.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Toss that out and come with me.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: You've got a lot to learn afore you can join a finship crew.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Finship? What finship?
